scope: Edited light-mode native walkthroughs at actual interaction speed. Each uses one continuous source interval, beginning at the populated library and ending before XCTest deliberately terminates the app to change appearance. No internal cuts, overlays, generated pixels or speed changes. Dark-mode captures are published separately. Five decoded samples and two decoded boundary frames per device were independently reviewed; sampling is not full playback.
